newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells out 65 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells out 65 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry issues of three- and six-month discount T-bills were sold out at Monday's auctions, yielding 2.46 and 4.87 percent to maturity, respectively, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two respective issues auctioned on June 23 stood at 2.55 and 4.99 percent.

The three-month issue was offered with a par value of 35 billion levs and the six-month T-bills were offered with a par of 30 billion levs. Both issues were offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 35,000 million levs 30,000 million levs
Bids received 44,145 million levs 61,357 million levs
Average price of bids 97.36 pct 94.48 pct
Bids approved 35,000 million levs 30,000 million levs
Average yield to maturity 2.46 pct 4.87 pct
